quiz.explanation: ausgehend: starting from; based on; outgoing.

options: to go out; to run out; to assume
quiz.answer: to go out; to run out; to assume

goodToKnow: Ausgehend von means starting from or based on: Ausgehend von dieser Annahme... It's the present participle of ausgehen, which has many meanings: to go out (in the evening), to run out (Das Geld geht aus), to go out of light (Das Licht ging aus) and to assume: Ich gehe davon aus, dass... (I assume that...). As an adjective, ausgehend means outgoing (ausgehende Anrufe) or ending: im ausgehenden 19. Jahrhundert.
